blockMcqs.question: What distinguishes observability from monitoring?
options: Observability is cheaper to run than monitoring
Monitoring uses traces; observability uses metrics
It lets you answer questions you didn't predict
blockMcqs.explanation: Monitoring watches known-unknowns; observability explores unknown-unknowns from emitted output.

blockMcqs.question: Which signal is best for "why did this one request fail?"
blockMcqs.explanation: Metrics throw away individual events, so per-request detail lives in logs.

blockMcqs.question: Why is structured logging higher-leverage than free-text logs?
options: It uses less disk space per line
It is queryable and pivots via trace_id
It removes the need for metrics
It guarantees no PII is logged
blockMcqs.explanation: Key-value JSON is machine-parseable, so you can filter, aggregate, and jump to traces.

blockMcqs.question: Which metric type lets you compute p99 latency?
blockMcqs.explanation: Only bucketed distributions expose percentiles; the mean would hide the tail.

blockMcqs.question: RED versus USE — what's the right split?
options: RED for resources, USE for services
RED for services, USE for resources
RED for logs, USE for traces
blockMcqs.explanation: RED detects the user-facing symptom; USE localizes the resource-level cause.

blockMcqs.question: How do spans on different machines reconnect into one trace?
options: By matching timestamps after the fact
Context propagation of trace and span IDs
The load balancer rewrites span IDs
blockMcqs.explanation: The caller injects IDs into headers so downstream spans become children.

blockMcqs.question: What is the error budget for a 99.9% SLO?
blockMcqs.explanation: Budget is 100% minus the SLO, about 43 minutes per month here.

blockMcqs.question: Which condition should page an on-call human?
options: A single host died in a large fleet
Error rate is burning the SLO fast
blockMcqs.explanation: Pages should fire on user-felt symptoms, not on causes the system tolerates.

blockMcqs.question: Why avoid putting user_id on a metric label?
options: It creates a cardinality bomb of series
blockMcqs.explanation: Each label combination is a new time series, so millions of users explode the backend.
